comparison.objective: Uprights a fallen bottle on a moving belt; candidate removes tangs from threaded inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Dynamic reorientation on a conveyor differs from narrow mandrel alignment, controlled striking, coil-safe withdrawal, and tiny-fragment retrieval.
comparison.success_condition: Bottle uprightness on the belt is title-supported; stability thresholds are missing. Candidate requires four physical fractures and four contained tangs without component damage.
comparison.reason: Dynamic object uprighting and precision impact finishing have different success states and failure modes.
